title: Ruth Meets Boaz

questions.question: Whose field did Ruth glean in?
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:3 (ESV): “...and she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz...”

questions.question: What was Boaz’s relation to Elimelech?
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:1 (ESV): “Now Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a worthy man of the clan of Elimelech, whose name was Boaz.”

questions.question: What did Boaz instruct his workers to do for Ruth?
options: Leave grain for her to glean
questions.correctAnswer: Leave grain for her to glean
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:15–16 (ESV): “...‘Let her glean even among the sheaves... Also pull out some from the bundles for her and leave it for her to glean...’”

questions.question: What did Ruth bring back to Naomi?
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:17 (ESV): “So she gleaned in the field until evening... and beat out what she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.”

questions.question: What did Naomi call Boaz after hearing of him?
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:20 (ESV): “And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, ‘...The man is a close relative of ours, one of our redeemers.’”

questions.question: How did Boaz greet his reapers?
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:4 (ESV): "And behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem. And he said to the reapers, 'The LORD be with you!'"

questions.question: What did the reapers answer Boaz?
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:4 (ESV): "...And they answered, 'The LORD bless you.'"

questions.question: Why did Boaz shout show favor to Ruth?
options: Because he heard of all she had done for her mother-in-law
questions.correctAnswer: Because he heard of all she had done for her mother-in-law
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:11 (ESV): "...All that you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband has been fully told to me..."

questions.question: Boaz told Ruth to stay close to whom?
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:8 (ESV): "...Do not go to glean in another field or leave this one, but keep close to my young women."

questions.question: What did Boaz offer Ruth at mealtime?
options: Roasted grain and bread dipped in sour wine
questions.correctAnswer: Roasted grain and bread dipped in sour wine
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:14 (ESV): "...Come here and eat some bread and dip your morsel in the wine... And he served her roasted grain..."

questions.question: Until the end of which harvests did Ruth glean?
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:23 (ESV): "So she kept close to the young women of Boaz, gleaning until the end of the barley and wheat harvests..."

questions.question: Where did Ruth ask permission to glean?
options: Among the sheaves after the reapers
questions.correctAnswer: Among the sheaves after the reapers
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:7 (ESV): "She said, 'Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the reapers.'"

questions.question: What did Ruth recount to Naomi about Boaz's instructions?
options: He said, "You must keep close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest"
questions.correctAnswer: He said, "You must keep close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest"
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:21 (ESV): "...He also said to me, 'You must keep close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.'" (See Footnote: or servants, mixed gender context in Hebrew often masculine plural).

questions.question: Naomi advised Ruth it is better to go out with whose group?
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:22 (ESV): "...It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his young women, lest in another field you be assaulted."

questions.question: What phrase did Boaz use to describe God's protection?
options: Under whose wings you have come to take refuge
questions.correctAnswer: Under whose wings you have come to take refuge
questions.explanation: Ruth 2:12 (ESV): "...under whose wings you have come to take refuge!"

key_verse_text: “The LORD repay you for what you have done, and a full reward be given you by the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge!” (ESV)
